mean_en: a large metal or wooden box of a standard size in which goods are packed so that they can easily be lifted onto a ship, train, etc. to be transported
sentence: These containers are filled with things from China.
sentence_trans: 这些集装箱里装满了从中国运来的东西。
word_etyma: con全部 + tain握住 + er表示物 → container容器，集装箱
